items.title: Brown & Brown (BRO) Appoints Erik Templin To Lead North America Employee Benefits
items.summary: Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) has appointed Erik Templin as Executive Managing Director for Employee Benefits, North America. Templin will oversee the firm’s entire North American employee benefits operation, including strategy, growth initiatives, and talent development. He steps into the role after advancing through multiple leadership positions within Brown & Brown’s benefits-focused businesses.
